user.title: Set up PureLink Matrix Switcher
user.description: Enter the connection details for your PureLink switcher. The matrix size is detected automatically in the next step. Web UI credentials are optional: when provided, entities use the input/output names configured on the switcher.

ports.title: Confirm matrix size
ports.description: Detected {detected} outputs from the switcher's status reply. Confirm or adjust the port counts below.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the switcher. Check the IP address, port, and that the device is powered on.
error.invalid_auth: The switcher's web UI rejected these credentials. Check the username and password, or leave both empty to skip name sync.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while probing the switcher. Check the Home Assistant logs.

save_preset.name: Save preset
save_preset.description: Create or update a preset slot on the switcher. Requires Web UI credentials on the integration.

name.name: Name
name.description: Preset name (up to 8 characters). Leave empty to keep the slot's current name.

routing.name: Routing
routing.description: Optional map of output number to input number (0 disconnects). Outputs you omit keep the current live routing. Leave empty to snapshot the current routing.

delete_preset.name: Delete preset
delete_preset.description: Reset a preset slot to unconfigured (empty). Requires Web UI credentials on the integration.
